title: restrictSubgame_deviate_liftSubgame

restrictSubgame_deviate_liftSubgame

Lean type

lean theorem restrictSubgame_deviate_liftSubgame {G : ExtensiveGame iota U} [(s : G.State) -> Fintype (G.Action s)] [DecidableEq iota] (beta : G.BehaviorProfile) (who : iota) {root : G.State} (beta' : (G.subgameAt root).BehaviorStrategy who) : (beta.deviate who beta'.liftSubgame).restrictSubgame root = (beta.restrictSubgame root).deviate who beta'
